A June 10, 2026 canon provenance node minted by Lee Sharks / MANUS against *The New Human Standing Canon v0.3*. It records Sappho’s archive-internal status as the **Living Tongue of New Human**, with the melic tradition inducted and Sappho serving as the load-bearing exemplar.

This is an archive routing object, not a substitute for Sapphic biography, textual criticism, or papyrology.
